purpose: Freeze one retrieval-only R1 hypothesis and one ranking-only K1 hypothesis for the factorized V5 B/R/K/RK development program before any V5D authoring or execution.

R0.dense_model: nomic-embed-text via frozen semantic recommender v2
R0.lexical_branch: frozen V4A deterministic BM25 over title+description
R0.union: deduplicate by isbn13; no pre-reranker truncation; maximum 100 unique candidates

K0.final_order: raw reranker_score descending; exact-score tie -> retrieval rank ascending -> isbn13 ascending

R1.hypothesis: Candidate recall for complex semantic queries can improve by replacing only the dense embedding model while keeping lexical retrieval, depths, fusion, candidate budget, and downstream ranking unchanged.

dense_branch.query_text: raw user query exactly as supplied
dense_branch.document_text: exact frozen R0 tagged_description line payload; no metadata enrichment or field rewrite
dense_branch.similarity: dot product on L2-normalized embeddings (cosine equivalent)
dense_branch.tie_break: isbn13 ascending after exact similarity tie

explicit_non_changes: no BM25 parameter or analyzer change

K1.hypothesis: Display ranking can improve by replacing only the cross-encoder reranker with a newer fixed reranker while preserving candidate sets and the score-only V4B ranking policy.

input.query: raw user query exactly as supplied

score_and_order.tie_equality: exact numeric equality; no epsilon bucket and no score rounding

K1.scope: rerank the complete candidate union supplied by R0 or R1; K1 performs no retrieval
K1.repeatability: two repeated inference passes must produce identical per-query rank-order signatures before semantic evaluation
explicit_non_changes: no retrieval-rank weight except exact-score tie-break
no score calibration or parameter sweep

factorial_composition.RK_rule: mechanical composition only; no third parameter set

implementation_freeze_requirements.freeze_before: V5D query authoring and any V5D retrieval/model execution

prohibited_before_v5d: using V4H query text/facets/candidate IDs/judge scores to choose parameters
running R1/K1 on V5D before implementation locks exist
authoring V5D queries before R1/K1 implementation locks exist
changing R1/K1 after first V5D semantic result
changing judge or release gates as part of this architecture step
